text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is changing how we work. Automation now handles many repetitive tasks, such as organizing data or answering simple customer questions. Productivity tools powered by AI help employees save time and focus on more important work. Many companies also encourage human-AI collaboration, where people and machines work together to solve problems faster. However, these changes also affect jobs. Some roles may disappear, while new ones appear. This means workers need to learn new skills and stay flexible. In the future, AI will not simply replace people, but it will change what we do and how we do it.
